title: Minimum orientative land values, from a chamber of notaries' market study
description: One county's land grid as its chamber of notaries publishes it. Two granularities that must not be flattened into one: intravilan values are printed per village, extravilan values once per commune. Towns and the occasional commune that has passed its own zoning decision are priced by zone letter instead, and a zone the locality does not have is recorded as null rather than as zero. Every value is a legal floor for notarial fees and transfer tax, not an observed transaction price.

value.description: EUR per square metre, or null where the study prints a dash because the locality has no such zone.

categoryValues.description: Prices by category. May be empty: a study does not always print an extravilan grid for every locality, and an absent price is absent rather than zero.

currency.description: The chamber's own unit. CNP Bacău prices in euro, CNP Alba Iulia in lei.

communes.description: Zero este legitim: Bucureștiul este un singur municipiu, fără comune și fără sate, iar minimul de 1 presupunea tăcut că orice județ are mediu rural.

villages.description: Zero este legitim: Bucureștiul este un singur municipiu, fără comune și fără sate, iar minimul de 1 presupunea tăcut că orice județ are mediu rural.

rosterComune.description: Zero este legitim: Bucureștiul este un singur municipiu, fără comune și fără sate, iar minimul de 1 presupunea tăcut că orice județ are mediu rural.

rosterMissingFromTable.description: Localities the register names that the study does not price. Recorded rather than forbidden: a gap in the source is not a reason to publish nothing about the rest of the county. Judge the file by summary.coverage.

tableMissingFromRoster.description: Communes the parse produced that the roster never names. Must be empty for the same reason, from the other direction.

townsWithoutZoneGrid.description: Localities the register names that the study does not price. Recorded rather than forbidden: a gap in the source is not a reason to publish nothing about the rest of the county. Judge the file by summary.coverage.

numberingProblems.description: Gaps in the study's own Nr. Crt. sequence. Must be empty.

duplicateLocalities.description: Localities the rural table yielded more than once. Must be empty: a duplicate would be counted twice by anything that sums land value.

coverage.description: How much of the county is priced. Below 0.9 the importer refuses to write at all, because that is a broken parse rather than a short document.

roster.description: The county's own list of its localities, from the study's organisation page. The authority the parse is measured against.

zoned.description: Localities priced by zone letter. Usually towns, but a commune that has passed its own zoning decision appears here too, which is why rank is recorded rather than assumed.

items.description: Eticheta zonei aşa cum o scrie camera. Majoritatea camerelor folosesc litere A–F; Craiova împarte municipiul în treisprezece secţiuni şi Galaţiul în douăzeci şi şase, aşa că litera merge până la Z, iar peste alfabet eticheta devine "Z01"; Bucureştiul numerotează 59 de zone cadastrale împărţite în subzone ("25-A3"), două dintre ele tăiate de calea ferată şi preţuite separat la nord şi la sud ("25-A3 N"). Tiparul rămâne strict: a fost pus aici ca să prindă exact greşeala de a scrie un nume de localitate într-un câmp de zonă, şi o listă deschisă de şiruri ar renunţa la asta.

matchedRoster.description: Whether the name the table printed resolved to one the roster names.

rank.description: The rank the county roster gives this name. Towns keep villages of their own, so a town legitimately appears in the rural table.

communes.description: Comunele judeţului, cu satele lor. Poate fi goală: Bucureştiul este un singur municipiu şi are zone, nu comune. Minimul de 1 codifica presupunerea tăcută că orice unitate din setul acesta are mediu rural, ceea ce capitala nu are.
